items.name: Greedy sorting key
items.description: Sort by a key that directly enables a greedy choice; use sorting.key_ordering for non-greedy preprocessing.

items.name: Exchange argument
items.description: Justify greedy choice by exchange argument.

items.name: Local choice
items.description: Make an immediately determined local choice that cannot hurt future feasibility or optimality.

items.name: Extreme choice
items.description: Choose the largest, smallest, earliest, latest, or otherwise extreme feasible option at each step.

items.name: Priority-queue choice
items.description: Repeatedly choose the currently best candidate from a priority queue or heap.

items.name: Reverse processing
items.description: Process operations in reverse so only the last effective choice for each object contributes.

items.name: Prefix optimality
items.description: Maintain an optimal prefix, selected prefix length, or prefix aggregate justified by greedy dominance.
